lines.say: Your building has three rules after midnight. Rule three is in your handwriting.
Rule one. Never open the door of nine F. Nobody lives there.
Rule two. If Doris knocks, do not answer. Doris moved out last year.
Twelve oh four. A knock. A sweet old voice. Have you got any sugar?
You read rule three. Your handwriting. It says: let her in. She is the only one protecting you.
Would you follow rule three? Write it in the comments.
